name: Suttsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Suttsu town emblem in navy: a broken ring enclosing a four-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Suttsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in 1965.

features.role: Suttsu town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a four-pointed star
